dedupe_keys.name: reinforcement learning for equitable bus based evacuations san francisco bay area

description: This framework by Fang Tang, Han Wang and Maria Laura Delle Monache (arXiv, December 2024) uses reinforcement learning to plan bus-based evacuations that are both efficient and equitable as natural disasters become more frequent. Coverage: the evacuation is modelled as a Markov decision process; the reinforcement learning agent dynamically reroutes buses from their scheduled locations to minimise total passenger evacuation time while prioritising equity-priority communities, using real-time transit data in General Transit Feed Specification form and road networks extracted from OpenStreetMap. Simulations on the San Francisco Bay Area network show significant gains in evacuation efficiency and equitable service distribution over rule-based and random strategies. Format and access: an arXiv preprint. Licence and cost: free to read; no licence stated on the abstract page. Caveats: simulation results; code is not mentioned on the abstract page. The rerouting policy can be tested in emergency response and evacuation simulations of transit networks. It relates to the GTFS specification and OpenStreetMap in the catalogue.
